surface: Complete React Number Format component and utility surface used by Mantine: NumberFormatBase, NumericFormat, PatternFormat, source-info helpers, caret utilities, and formatting/removal functions.
divergences: Input callbacks receive native browser events through Octane instead of React synthetic events.
Refs are ordinary props and do not use React.forwardRef.
ssr: Formatting is deterministic during server rendering; interactive caret correction activates only in the browser.
